rule_or_pattern: Drop lines flagged C:height_ratio_high or C:cpp_vs_book_out (crops taller than the page's normal line height: two small-type lines beside figures squeezed into one box, with a label from only one of them or from a neighbouring line).
notes: This is an 1871 polytonic physics textbook. Body lines (2-18) and the running titles and book headings (24-35) read correctly, with good polytonic marks and the letter labels of the figures. Lines next to figures on pages 157 and 303 (19, 21-23, 36-40) have crops two lines tall, with a label taken from a different line ('ἀτμῶν διὰ τοῦ' under 'Πρὸς εὕρεσιν δὲ τῆς ἐλαστικῆς δυνάμεως...'). These are all flagged C:height_ratio_high or C:cpp_vs_book_out. One random line (1) has a label shifted relative to its crop with no flag, so some residue remains. The book is in the dev split.
